seo.title: Cairnly for career professionals | career assessment for return-to-work and outplacement
seo.description: Use Cairnly as prep work in your program: concrete careers with match scores, salary data and an AI-impact rating per career, under your logo. Credits never expire, no setup fees.

hero.title: Your candidate starts with direction, not a blank page
hero.body: Cairnly is an online career assessment that turns 25 to 40 minutes into concrete careers: a top 3 with match scores, alternatives, salary ranges and, for every career, an honest read on what AI will do to it. Your logo on the report, the real conversation stays yours.
hero.stageCaption: Marcel and Emma are fictional candidates, everything you see is real output. Click a screen or a card to open the session: the conversation with the coach and the dashboard that follows.

whoFor.title: Who it's for
whoFor.body: For return-to-work agencies (spoor 2 in the Netherlands), outplacement firms and independent career coaches. Cairnly doesn't replace your existing toolkit, it sits in front of it: the candidate works through the assessment as prep work and arrives at your advisor with a report to talk through.

whatYouGet.title: What your candidate gets
items: A top 3 of careers that fit, with a match score on each, plus alternatives and a few less obvious directions that still match the profile.
Per career: why it fits this person, salary ranges and an AI-impact rating from Minimal to Critical. Which direction is growing and which is shrinking, essential when retraining is on the table.
An AI coach the candidate uses to discuss the report and correct it where it is wrong. The report is not a static verdict.
A PDF report with your logo and name on it, which the candidate brings to the conversation with you.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: One credit is one full assessment, including the report and the AI coach. Credits never expire. No setup fees, no certification, no contract, no minimum. When you sign up you get 3 free credits to experience what your candidate gets.
pricing.note: For comparison: consumers will soon pay 59 euro per assessment. You decide whether you pass the credits on or absorb them into your program.

pilot.title: Want to see it work first? Fair enough.
pilot.bodyBeforeEmail: We're looking for a handful of agencies for a free pilot: 20 candidates, no strings attached. What we ask back is an honest opinion from your advisors. Email

items.a: No, and we don't claim it is. Cairnly is labor-market orientation: it translates someone's experience, values and preferences into concrete career directions. It sits alongside your validated instruments (COTAN-rated in the Netherlands), not in place of them.

items.q: What about privacy and the GDPR?
items.a: The candidate works through the assessment themselves and owns their own report. Payments run through Stripe on EU servers. Cairnly is a self-directed orientation tool that the candidate completes about themselves, not a selection instrument, and we don't supply assessments of candidates to employers.

items.q: Can the report carry my own name?
items.a: Your logo and name appear on the report and on the page where your candidates start the assessment. Full white-label (your own domain, your own payment environment) is not something we offer at the moment.

items.q: What does it cost my candidate?
items.a: Nothing. You buy credits, the candidate redeems a code. There is no price and no paywall between your candidate and the report.

closing.body: Cairnly is a product of Human in the Loop B.V., Utrecht. Partners who join on or before October 15 pay the current beta rate on their first credit pack.

landing.title: Start your career assessment
landing.body: {{partner}} has set this assessment up for you. In 25 to 40 minutes you answer questions about your personality, your work history and what you are looking for in work. You then receive a report with concrete careers that fit you, each with a match score, a salary range and an honest read on what AI will do to it. You bring that report to the conversation with your advisor.
steps: Work through the assessment at your own pace, in stages if you like
Receive your report and talk it through with the coach and with your advisor

candidateStart.title: How your candidate starts
candidateStart.body: You send your candidate a personal link. It opens a start page with your logo and name, a short explanation and one button. The access code sits in the link, so there is nothing to type over. After the button the candidate creates an account and starts the assessment.
points: Your logo and name at the top, before Cairnly comes into view
An explanation in three steps, in Dutch or English, you choose per link
No price, no paywall: the candidate only sees the start
